mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_node_config (chain_code, node_id, node_code, node_name, node_type, sort_no, parallel_group, request_url, request_method, request_headers, body_type, body_data, extract_rules, assert_rules, variable_mapping, delay_seconds, biz_oper_trace_id, trigger_event, target_dom, page_url, window_id, ignore) VALUES (#{chainCode}, #{nodeId}, #{nodeCode}, #{nodeName}, #{nodeType}, #{sortNo}, #{parallelGroup}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestHeaders}, #{bodyType}, #{bodyData}, #{extractRules}, #{assertRules}, #{variableMapping}, #{delaySeconds}, #{bizOperTraceId}, #{triggerEvent}, #{targetDom}, #{pageUrl}, #{windowId}, #{ignore})

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM test_node_config WHERE chain_code = #{chainCode} AND node_code = #{nodeCode}

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_no), 0) FROM test_node_config WHERE chain_code = #{chainCode}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(node_id), 0) FROM test_node_config WHERE chain_code = #{chainCode}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_node_config WHERE chain_code = #{chainCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_node_config SET sort_no = sort_no + 1 WHERE chain_code = #{chainCode} AND sort_no >= #{fromSortNo}
